name: Google Maps
tips: Map keys work only when the map itself has focus: press Tab until the map is focused. A square then highlights part of the map and a numbered list of places in it appears below.
With the map focused, pressing the number shown next to a place opens details about it.
When the highlighted area holds more than 7 places, 9 shows more of them and 8 goes back.
Arrow keys move the map; with shift held they move it by one whole square.
ctrl+/ opens the list of shortcuts inside Maps. The help page gives this key as Ctrl only, with no separate Mac key.
mod+Plus, mod+- and mod+0 are the browser page zoom (bigger, smaller, reset), which enlarges what is on the page; the map zoom keys are Plus and - alone.
